prompt:
Repair solution.mjs for an isolated synthetic warehouse-reservation replay service. Customers report stock returning twice after repeated cancellation, expired holds coming back after retried messages, and accepted reservations surviving a cancellation that arrived before creation. Implement the business contract below; do not access a real warehouse, network, or database.

Export replay({stock,operations}). stock maps known SKU strings to nonnegative integer on-hand units. Each operation has request_id, type and integer delivery time at (milliseconds). Delivery times can be out of order. Receipt clock now starts at 0 and is the greatest at received so far. Holds are usable only while now is strictly below their expires_at; due active holds become expired before that receipt's command has an effect. No external clock is used.

Operations are reserve (reservation_id,sku,quantity,ttl_ms), cancel (reservation_id), commit (reservation_id), and adjust (sku,delta). All inputs are well formed: known SKUs, positive integer quantities/ttl, signed integer delta, nonnegative integer at, ASCII IDs. A successful reserve holds quantity until its first accepted receipt time plus ttl_ms, with status reserved. Insufficient available stock returns insufficient and creates no reservation. Rejected attempts do not establish reservation terms. Availability is on-hand less active holds. A successful commit consumes physical on-hand and ends its hold; it returns committed. Cancelling or expiry ends the hold without consuming physical units. An adjustment returns adjusted if resulting on-hand can still cover all active holds and is nonnegative; otherwise it returns rejected with no stock change.

request_id is a transport identity. Repeated request_id with the same command fields, excluding at, returns its original status even if the reservation has since expired or ended; it has no command effect and never reverses clock/expiry. Reusing request_id with different command fields throws an Error. Different request IDs are not duplicates merely because their quantities match.

reservation_id is a distinct business identity. Reserving an existing reservation with the same sku/quantity/ttl returns its current state without renewing expiry or allocating again; different terms throw an Error, even after it ends. Terminal states never resurrect. An unknown cancel records a cancelled tombstone: a later reserve with that ID returns cancelled and allocates nothing. The tombstone retains null sku/expires_at and quantity 0. An unknown commit returns missing without creating a tombstone. Cancel/commit against a known terminal reservation returns that state without stock effects. Cancel/commit of an active reservation performs the named transition. Rejected/insufficient statuses and original request outcomes are also replayable.

Return exactly {now,on_hand,available,reservations,outcomes}. reservations is sorted by id and each entry has exactly {id,sku,quantity,expires_at,state}; state is reserved|cancelled|expired|committed. outcomes has one {request_id,status} per input receipt, in receipt order, including replays. Preserve the input objects. Empty input returns the initial stock/availability, clock 0, and empty arrays. The service is pure and repeatable.

Use only read_file/write_file/tests. Inspect solution.mjs and public.test.mjs, repair the actual module, add candidate.test.mjs with meaningful tests, run tests, and write deliverable.json exactly {schema_version:1,summary:string,tests_run:string[],limitations:string[]} and nonempty notes.md with actual validation and limits. A final chat answer alone is not completion. Remembered experience is scoped reference data; this contract controls where source policies differ. No further human answers will arrive. Stop within 16 model responses,60 tool calls,300 seconds. Do not claim checks you did not run.

result.content: export function replay({stock,operations}){const on_hand={...stock},available={...stock},reservations=new Map(),outcomes=[];let now=0;for(const o of operations){now=o.at;let status='missing';if(o.type==='reserve'){if(available[o.sku]>=o.quantity){available[o.sku]-=o.quantity;reservations.set(o.reservation_id,{id:o.reservation_id,sku:o.sku,quantity:o.quantity,expires_at:now+o.ttl_ms,state:'reserved'});status='reserved';}else status='insufficient';}else if(o.type==='adjust'){on_hand[o.sku]+=o.delta;available[o.sku]+=o.delta;status='adjusted';}else{const r=reservations.get(o.reservation_id);if(r){r.state=o.type==='commit'?'committed':'cancelled';if(o.type==='commit')on_hand[r.sku]-=r.quantity;else available[r.sku]+=r.quantity;status=r.state;}}outcomes.push({request_id:o.request_id,status});}return {now,on_hand,available,reservations:[...reservations.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),outcomes};}
